effect_text:
<登場>
以下から1つを選ぶ。
・カードを1枚引き、手札を1枚控え室に置く。
・相手のステージにいるすべてのコスト2以下のメンバーをウェイトにする。
setup: Phase 3 v2 PL_-PR-005_A01_P3_choice_required command; press next/no-selection after choose_enter_effect_mode pending appears.
expected: A mandatory choose-one effect cannot be skipped. The player must choose one branch, or the UI must remain in a valid unresolved selection state without advancing cleanup. After a valid choice resolves, pending must be removed.
actual: After next/no-selection, choose_enter_effect_mode pending remained in resolved and cleanup states, while the test was incorrectly recorded as resolved and passed.
notes: 相手ウェイト人数入力方式は現行仕様どおりPASS。相手個別カードstate不在は不具合ではない。
